tex_content.source:
\label{sec:laplace-energy-uniqueness}

Let $U$ be bounded with $C^1$ boundary and consider
$$(46)\qquad
\begin{cases}
-\Delta u=f&\text{in }U,\\
u=g&\text{on }\partial U.
\end{cases}$$
